name: college-erp
description: Enterprise Academic College ERP - Round 1 Design & Round 2 Verified MVP

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run db:push && npm --prefix backend run db:seed && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:prod: cd backend && npx prisma db push && (node -e 'if(process.env.ALLOW_SEED==="true") require("./dist/prisma/seed").seedDatabase()') && node dist/index.js
